evidence.section: 3.2 Effect of Pre-deformation on Aging Behavior
evidence.quote: From the [0001]Mg direction, the precipitates mainly show three orientations on the basal plane and their sizes are around 9 nm.
The as-extruded alloy exhibits a typical dynamic recrystallization (DRX) microstructure with the average grain size of 6.5 lm.

The dislocations either pile up at grain boundaries forming dislocation walls or entangle with each other forming networks, which can divide grains into many cellular structures with small angular differences.

The increase of yield strength of the alloy with thermomechanical treatment mainly comes from dislocation strengthening and precipitation strengthening.
Deformation strengthening in the alloy is mainly caused by the increased dislocation density during deformation.

High-density dislocations introduced by the deformation process provide nucleation sites for the precipitated phase of the aged alloy and promote nucleation, thus shortening the peak aging time and reﬁning the precipitates.
